test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the following expression: 

(cos theta)/(1-sin theta)+(1-sin theta)/(cos theta)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 0°** to simplify the expression quickly.

When θ = 0°, cos 0° = 1 and sin 0° = 0.

Expression = (1 / (1 − 0)) + ((1 − 0) / 1) = 1 + 1 = 2.

Check options: 2 sec 0° = 2 × 1 = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 sec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (cos theta)/(1-sin theta)+(1-sin theta)/(cos theta)

**Formula Used:** sin² θ + cos² θ = 1; sec θ = 1/cos θ

⇒ Taking **LCM**: [cos² θ + (1 − sin θ)²] / [cos θ(1 − sin θ)]

⇒ Expanding (1 − sin θ)²: [cos² θ + 1 + sin² θ − 2 sin θ] / [cos θ(1 − sin θ)]

⇒ Using **Identity** (sin² θ + cos² θ = 1): [1 + 1 − 2 sin θ] / [cos θ(1 − sin θ)]

⇒ [2 − 2 sin θ] / [cos θ(1 − sin θ)]

⇒ [2(1 − sin θ)] / [cos θ(1 − sin θ)]

⇒ 2 / cos θ = 2 sec θ

**∴ The correct answer is 2 sec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Primary identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

sec θ = 1/cos θ, cosec θ = 1/sin θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ.</p
